dimensions.name: Autonomous operations
dimensions.blocker: The latest premium website run still depends on operator-driven diagnosis and repair: Phase 1A failed the creative-quality objective, fulfillment is currently frozen, and 5 of 6 Phase 1C quick-study rounds hit the turn limit before writing a page.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Normal live use continues to expose production-only failure classes despite a large green test suite; PRs #95-#98 fixed four separate Phase 1C defects in hours and PR #99 remains open for the next one.

dimensions.name: Customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: Payment and workflow plumbing are materially built, but there is still no clean paid end-to-end completion and the premium website path has not cleared its current private quality cycle.

dimensions.name: AI / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: The agent stack is capable, but current implementer behavior still wastes bounded turns on unnecessary inspection and can fail to take the required write action without a deterministic correction.

dimensions.name: Website Builder maturity
dimensions.blocker: Phase 1A proved the pipeline but 5 of 5 rendered studies failed the craft/anti-slop floor; the Phase 1C rerun has not yet produced a passing premium study after the new design-system and critique architecture.

dimensions.name: Commercial readiness
dimensions.blocker: The offer, checkout and customer plumbing are credible, but commercial readiness is capped until the core premium deliverable can be fulfilled repeatedly without operator rescue.

dimensions.name: Acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: No repeatable customer-acquisition channel or proven lead-to-paid conversion loop exists yet, and the public company still reports no customers.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: No verified paying Stromation customers or recurring revenue exist yet; the venture portfolio remains parked and its last property was retired.

changed: The single biggest change is hard creative-quality and reliability evidence from the first serious premium Website Builder cycle: Phase 1A proved the pipeline but all 5 rendered studies failed the engine's own craft/anti-slop floor, and the Phase 1C rerun immediately exposed several production-only defects before 5 of 6 quick-study rounds hit the turn limit without writing. The new design-system, critique, fan-out and timing architecture is substantial progress, but it has not yet converted into unattended premium fulfillment.
method: Expanded independent forecast grounded in Sep. 11-12 main-branch implementation through PR #98, the Phase 1A final run report, live Phase 1C failures and merged repairs, open PR #99 as unmerged corrective work, the current public Stromation offer and explicit no-customer disclosure, parked venture status, and absence of verified recurring revenue. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
